blocks.task: use them to test yourself or a partner.

questions.q: What changed when people learned to farm?
questions.a: They settled in villages instead of moving
questions.model: Before: they moved to find food. After: they grew food. So they stayed in one place. Villages like Skara Brae grew.

questions.q: How did the Celts pass on their history?
End-of-unit quiz: answer the 10 questions on the portal (periods, Skara Brae, Stonehenge, metals, hill forts).
questions.a: Answers on the portal quiz key
questions.model: Teacher does question 1 aloud: 'Which came first, bronze or iron?' Bronze.

questions.q: Complete the timeline task: put six events in order with dates.
questions.a: Hunter-gatherers; farming about 4000 BC; Stonehenge stones about 2500 BC; Bronze Age about 2500 BC; Iron Age about 800 BC; Romans AD 43

questions.q: What was the biggest change from the Stone Age to the Iron Age? Give a reason.
questions.a: For example: farming, because people settled and built villages

questions.q: Big question: how did people remember their history without books?
questions.a: Storytellers learned it by heart and passed it on, and objects they left are clues for us
